stream_proto.label: Preferred ORF protocol
stream_proto.description: Used for ORF stations (template-based). Privates use explicit URLs from bundle.json.

stream_quality.label: ORF quality
stream_quality.description: For ORF HLS: q1a/q2a/q3a/q4a/qxa. For shoutcast: q1a/q2a.

catchup_proto.label: Catch-up stream type
catchup_proto.description: Use 'progressive' (mp3) or 'hls' (m3u8) URLs from the broadcast detail.

catchup_stations.label: Catch-up stations (optional)
catchup_stations.description: Comma-separated station ids (e.g. 'stm,wie,oe1'). Empty = all ORF stations from bundle.

manifest.description: Stream live radio and on-demand content from ORF Radiothek (Austrian public service broadcaster). Supports live streams from Ö1, Ö3, FM4, and regional stations, plus on-demand broadcasts and podcasts.
